{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the status column for unique values
status_values = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Check the revenue column for distribution
revenue_stats = sales_df['revenue'].describe()

missing_values, duplicates, status_values, revenue_stats"}
